gdgDescription: Google Developer Groups (GDGs) are local communities of developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts who are passionate about Google technologies and open source. We gather to learn, share ideas, and collaborate on projects. GDGs are independent groups; our activities and the opinions expressed here should in no way be linked to Google, the corporation.

codeOfConduct.summary: Our DevFest is dedicated to providing a harassment-free conference experience for everyone, regardless of gender, gender identity and expression, age, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, ethnicity, religion (or lack thereof), or technology choices. We do not tolerate harassment of conference participants in any form.
